mistake_reason: Tool Output Misinterpretation (FM-4.2): The WebSurfer clearly reported the Wikipedia upper estimate as 5×10^7 (50,000,000) individuals. At step 12, Orchestrator misparsed this unambiguous tool output and set the denominator to 5,000,000, a factor-of-10 error. This led to computing 0.00330 instead of the correct 0.00033. The agent further ignored a subsequent correction from WebSurfer, compounding the misinterpretation of the tool’s output.
